acceptance.evidence: AST/import namespace adversary plus default-deny credential-open probe.
acceptance.requirement: Package exposes only zero-argument execute_live and no reachable seam/sentinel/path/root/token/executor-factory bypass.

acceptance.evidence: missing and tampered grant/review rejection tests.
acceptance.requirement: Exact live grant and distinct review are byte pinned and semantically exact before output or credential access.

acceptance.evidence: mode, owner, symlink, ancestor swap and final-file swap adversaries.
acceptance.requirement: Fixed auth chain is opened descriptor-relatively from held root with nofollow, exact uid/type/mode and drift checks.

acceptance.evidence: official-shape valid and invalid matrices source-grounded in pinned v0.167 Rust members.
acceptance.requirement: All eight official AuthDotJson fields and nested token/provenance/agent/Bedrock shapes accept legitimate nullable forms and reject invalid types, unknowns, escaped duplicates, malformed and nonfinite documents.

acceptance.evidence: captured source wipe, capability count, recursive exception-graph adversaries.
acceptance.requirement: Only tokens.access_token leaves the mutable parse tree and token/raw buffers are synchronously overwritten on success and failure.

acceptance.evidence: loopback narrow E2E and closed execution receipt.
acceptance.requirement: One direct catalog execution has exactly one physical forward and zero retry/replay/auth recovery/status/inference/bytedcli effects.

acceptance.evidence: short/zero write, crash, post-crash second execution and post-commit second execution tests.
acceptance.requirement: Raw, membership and execution artifacts publish atomically and COMMITTED is written last; uncertainty fences replay.

acceptance.evidence: exact v1 hashes, preserved suites and active registration scan.
acceptance.requirement: v1 source/evidence, direct catalog/provider and active runtime remain unchanged/unregistered.

falsifiers: any provider, DNS, non-loopback, bytedcli, account, business, email or inference effect
any package-reachable execution callable other than execute_live
any accepted invalid official field shape or rejected tested official valid shape
token or raw response marker in recursive exception graph
review_gate: fresh independent security/correctness review must rehash the closure and adversarially verify OPEN-CB-001..003 before any CLEAN claim; separate exact live grant/review and future-triggered runtime acceptance remain subsequent gates
